```yaml
name: Build Container

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-push:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        id: buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v2

      - name: Login to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v2
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        id: build
        env:
          IMAGE_NAME: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}/codenameone-build:${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64 -t $IMAGE_NAME .
          docker push $IMAGE_NAME
```

```yaml
name: Pull Request CI

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, 'ubuntu-24.04']
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java-version: [8, 17, 21]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Use cached JDK
        uses: actions/setup-java@v3
        with:
          distribution: 'zulu'
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java-version }}
          cache: true

      - name: Link pre-downloaded cn1-binaries
        run: |
          ln -s /path/to/cn1-binaries ~/CodenameOne/bin

      - name: Run build script
        run: ./build.sh
```

```dockerfile
# .ci/container/Dockerfile
FROM ubuntu:24.04

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y wget unzip git && \
    wget https://cdn.azul.com/zulu/bin/zulu8.50.0.21-ca-jdk8.0.302-linux-x64.tar.gz && \
    tar zxvf zulu8.50.0.21-ca-jdk8.0.302-linux-x64.tar.gz -C /usr/lib/jvm && \
    rm zulu8.50.0.21-ca-jdk8.0.302-linux-x64.tar.gz && \
    update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/java java /usr/lib/jvm/zulu-8-amd64/bin/java 1 && \
    update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/javac javac /usr/lib/jvm/zulu-8-amd64/bin/javac 1

RUN apt-get install -y openjdk-17-jdk && \
    update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/java java /usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64/bin/java 2 && \
    update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/javac javac /usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64/bin/javac 2

RUN apt-get install -y openjdk-21-jdk && \
    update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/java java /usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64/bin/java 3 && \
    update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/javac javac /usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64/bin/javac 3

ENV JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/zulu-8-amd64
ENV PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH

COPY cn1-binaries /home/user/CodenameOne/bin
```
